title: airborne microbe Raw sequence reads
description: we plan to perform an integrated characterization of the airborne microbe community in different sizes of particles using a high-throughput culture-independent method, demonstrating that differences were found among different types of samples. We want to find the differences of microbial composition between non-haze and haze day.
center: Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences & Peking Union Medical College
